title: Hardkernel ODROID-M2
notes: 90 x 90 mm, four 3.3 mm holes at (3.5, 3.5), (86.5, 3.5), (86.5, 75.5) and (16.6, 78.5) mm from the corner between the edge with the microSD slot and the edge with the GPIO header (official PCB mechanical drawing rev 1.0, DXF, and 3D model rev 1.0).
l = 0 is the microSD edge, s = 0 the GPIO-header edge, which faces the back plate. The microSD edge is away from the frame in upright landscape and shelf portrait.
Most ports are along the edge opposite the GPIO header. The microSD card sticks out 9.9 mm past its edge, on top of the board, and the USB-C port on that edge sticks out 1.4 mm.

Under the board are a connector next to the UART label (6.8 mm deep; a surface rather than a solid in the 3D model), the RTC battery holder (6.5 mm), the M.2 slot (5.5 mm) and the standoff for an M.2 2280 SSD (4.1 mm).
Standoffs 8 mm tall: the connector by the UART label reaches 6.8 mm below the board and an SSD on the 4.1 mm M.2 standoff about 6.5 mm. 6 mm across: the nearest part is 3.4 mm from a hole centre.
Two rows of windows, clear of the standoffs.
